components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action trigger for organizing and saving tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5B3EE8; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 10px 20px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #4A2FD0; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05), 0 2px 4px rgba(91, 62, 232, 0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4A2FD0; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(91, 62, 232, 0.25); }

components.name: Priority Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-pill-high { background: #FDF2F4; color: #A11D33; border: 1px solid #F9D5DC; }

narrative.overview: A serene, high-contrast digital planner designed to eliminate cognitive clutter through disciplined typographic hierarchy, crisp porcelain surfaces, and purposeful iris accents.
keyCharacteristics: Pristine Contrast: High-contrast violet-slate typography on soft pearl canvas.
Purposeful Iris Accent: Reserved strictly for primary interactions and progress indicators.
Refined Tactility: Subtle borders and soft-focus ambient elevation without heavy drop shadows.
Zero Eyebrow Policy: Bold, self-sufficient headlines with natural authority.

rules.name: The Iris Focus Rule
rules.body: The royal iris accent is reserved strictly for interactive primary actions and active state focus.

rules.name: The No-Mud Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is tinted with cool slate-violet, never a washed-out mid-gray on colored surfaces.

dos: Do keep text contrast above 4.5:1 on all surfaces.
Do use pure white text (#FFFFFF) on primary iris action buttons.
Do provide smooth micro-transitions on interactive hover states.
donts: Don't use kicker/eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't force pure black text (#000000) onto pastel buttons.
Don't use right-aligned tabs that disconnect navigation from content.
